fields.name: localizedName
fields.notes: Display name for this content. Can also be set via bundle.

fields.name: description
fields.notes: Description text. Can also be set via bundle.

fields.name: details
fields.notes: Detailed description shown in the database.

fields.name: hidden
fields.notes: If true, this content is hidden from the database.

fields.name: alwaysUnlocked
fields.notes: If true, this content is always available regardless of tech tree progress.

fields.name: hideDetails
fields.notes: If true, details are hidden until the content is researched.

fields.name: hideDatabase
fields.notes: If true, this content does not appear in the database at all.

fields.name: generateIcons
fields.notes: If false, icons will not be auto-generated from the content type.

fields.name: inlineDescription
fields.notes: If true, the description is inlined from a bundle, not the JSON field.

fields.name: allDatabaseTabs
fields.notes: If true, this content shows up in all database tab categories.

fields.name: databaseCategory
fields.notes: Custom database category for grouping this content.

fields.name: databaseTag
fields.notes: Custom database search tag for this content.

fields.name: selectionSize
fields.notes: Size of the selection box in the editor.

fields.name: research
fields.notes: Name of the parent node in the tech tree, or a research object. If empty, content is not researchable.
